stories.title: ESPN's Jesse Palmer narrates a couple's breakup in the stands
stories.summary: During Georgia Tech's loss to Wake Forest, cameras found a couple mid-argument and The Bachelor host broke it down like game film. A few minutes later, the cameras caught them kissing.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in Palm Springs
stories.summary: Cyrus wed the Liily drummer in a poolside ceremony where guests were asked to wear black.
